comments.body:
Discovery can be made from Geography map. Map is sometimes awarded by any Scholar after reinvestigating the Lake Baikal Region (inland region of Sea of Okhotsk West Coast landing).

Map award is not 100%. Scholar will sometimes award other gifts such as Perfume or Landmark Ribbons.
